download_fao_data(): 下载FAO全球捕捞产量数据的某个版本

Source: vignettes/articles/zh/reference/download_fao_data.Rmd
download_fao_data.Rmd

英文原页：download_fao_data()

说明

该函数从FAO下载全球捕捞产量（Global Capture Production）的某个版本，将其转换为与包自带数据（Global_Production_long）相同的长格式，并以.rds文件保存在data_dir中。

English

This function downloads a Global Capture Production release from FAO, converts it to the same long format as the data bundled with the package (Global_Production_long), and saves it as an .rds file in data_dir.

用法 

download_fao_data(
  version = "latest",
  data_dir = fao_data_dir(),
  overwrite = FALSE,
  quiet = FALSE
)

参数

version
要下载的版本，如”2026.1.0”。默认为”latest”，即线上最新版本。FAO服务器上没有的版本会报错，并列出可用的版本。
English The release to download, e.g. “2026.1.0”. Default is “latest”.
data_dir
转换后数据的保存目录。默认为fao_data_dir()。
English The directory where the converted data is saved. Default is fao_data_dir().
overwrite
逻辑值。为FALSE（默认）时，已经下载过的版本直接从磁盘读取，不再重新下载；为TRUE时重新下载。
English A logical value. If FALSE (default), a release that was already downloaded is read from disk instead of being downloaded again.
quiet
逻辑值。为TRUE时不显示进度信息。默认为FALSE。
English A logical value. If TRUE, progress messages are not printed. Default is FALSE.

返回值

以不可见方式返回一个数据框，其列与Global_Production_long相同。

English

Invisibly, a data frame with the columns of Global_Production_long.

详细说明

国家和物种名称通过其FAO代码匹配到包自带数据所用的名称，因此结果可以直接用于现有的分析函数和中文名称表。与包自带数据一样，只保留以活重吨计的产量。

English

Country and species names are matched through their FAO codes to the names used by the bundled data, so the result works with the existing analysis functions and Chinese name tables. Only quantities in tonnes live weight are kept, as in the bundled data.

另请参阅

Other FAO data: check_fao_update(), fao_data_dir(), fao_data_info(), load_fao_data()

示例 

check_fao_update()
new_data <- download_fao_data()
